description: Trash redundant duplicate copies and empty folders under a path; nothing is deleted and drive_undo restores them. The server lists the items from a fresh, complete scan: you name no files; kept copies, shared items and names already in the trash are left out. Without confirmed: plan (counts, bytes, 10 samples, skipped, remaining). With confirmed=true the server first asks the user to approve the exact list, and trashes nothing if Drive changed meanwhile. Max 50 per call; call again while remaining > 0.

confirmed.description: Plan/apply switch: false or absent returns the plan only and changes nothing; true applies it after the server has asked the user to approve the exact list.

verify.description: sha256-verify duplicates first (needed for shared items; slower).

name: drive_cleanup
title: Clean up duplicates and empty folders
